title: formal-companion overlay configuration, version 1
description: Section 3 of the overlay contract. The identifier above names this schema and is never fetched. The authoritative implementations are scripts/overlay/config.py in the formal-companion skill and tools/check_generated.py beside this file; they repeat these five patterns and the license list verbatim and a test fails when a string differs. A loopback host is written 127.x.y.z or ::1.

source_id.description: The PDF the overlay shows: the source_id in the overlay extension of its records' PDF ends.

strip_prefix.description: A declaration-name prefix the cards hide; the empty string hides nothing.

minimal.description: Keep the passage, its links and their statements, and leave out what describes them: the status chip (still read by a screen reader, shown when focused or when the PDF is not verified), the keys line, the key and related counts and the name filter, card kinds and badges, related-row role and kind words, the review footer, the ledger cluster and the 'Formalized' word. Qualifying words, where a link goes, the notice, pagers and verdicts with their caveat stay. Default false.

route.description: Starts with /__, names a file, holds no `..`. Defaults to /__overlay_pdf__/<file_name>. Not used when the PDF is published.

publish.description: Opt in to publishing the PDF with the built site, at <mount>/<file_name> beside this file, so the overlay works from a static host. Only for a PDF under one of these open licenses (SPDX ids), and the file name then ends in .pdf. Without it the PDF is served only on loopback, at the route.

commands.description: Each entry is one argv, run with no shell. The default is no command at all.

relative_path.description: A normalised, traversal-free path inside the companion: no leading slash, no empty, `.` or `..` segment, no trailing slash, no backslash and no control character.
